note: HELIOS convective adjustment and the finite mixing-length closure are different convection models. These gates score a matched-column RCE benchmark, not bit-identity of the two solvers. Frozen before any live coupled HELIOS RCE run.

norms.toa_flux_rel: |F_top - F_int| / F_int on each solver, and |F_top,HELIOS - F_top,MLT| / F_int
norms.max_rel_T: max |T_HELIOS - T_MLT| / max(|T_MLT|, 1 K) interpolated onto the MLT pressure centres
norms.topology: single bottom-connected convective zone; no detached convective cells
norms.energy_closure_rel: |F_bot - F_int| / F_int and |column energy residual| / F_int
